sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam.
On site gearing up to patrol.
Heading out on patrol; checking on surrounding businesses.

Starbucks, Localito, Queen Street McDonald's and 77 Convenience Store all clear. Roads blocked off from Wellesley Street towards Aotea Square for the Diwali festival; expecting high foot traffic and security presence from Council, Police and security due to the Prime Minister and Brian Tamaki attending the event later today. Will return frequently when available; standing by for security presence.
Heading up Wellesley Street towards Federal Street.
Arrived at corner of Victoria and Federal Street; welfare check on Remedy Coffee, 77 Convenience Store, Eighty Fed, Amelia Cafe and Coffee Club, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
St Patrick's Square and Cathedral all clear; checking on surrounding businesses.
Welfare check at corner of Wyndham and Albert Street — Hollywood Cafe, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading down Albert Street towards Lower Albert.
Arrived at Lower Albert Street; checking on surrounding businesses.
Woolworths all clear, no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
Heading to check on Commercial Bay, TK Square and McDonald's.

Commercial Bay, TK Square, Kowhai Coffee, the flea market behind Britomart and Britomart McDonald's all clear. Another event appears to be setting up here as well — assumed to be Brian Tamaki's supporters. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Gore Street via Customs Street.
Custom Mart, Coffee Club, 77 Convenience Store and Sol all clear; continuing checks on surrounding businesses.
Welfare checks on P&K Liquor, Auckland Harbour Suites, Smiley Mart, Chargrill and Gore Street, all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare check, all clear; heading towards Chancery Square via High Street:
Welfare check on Haven Mart, Shortland Minimart, Barkers and stores up to High Street Supermarket, plus businesses on Vulcan Lane — no issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
All businesses from Unity Books up to Tatty's Designer's and Freyberg Square, including the upstairs area, all clear. Heading to check in on Chancery Square.
All clear at Chancery Square; standing by for security presence.
Received a call for assistance down at Britomart McDonald's; heading down now.
Arrived at Britomart McDonald's; asked to move Brian Tamaki's supporters from the front of the store.
Relocated the group to sell their merchandise on the opposite side by Britomart train station. Standing by for security presence as supporter numbers continue to grow. (Photos on file.)
Welfare checks from Swarovski all the way up to Farmers and Mecca — no issues to report. Heading up to HQ.
Taking a 10-minute break to use the restroom and rest.
Welfare checks from Starbucks up to Acceco and NZ Muscle — no issues from businesses. Received a free drink voucher from McDonald's Queen Street. Heading towards Elliott and Darby Street.
All clear on Elliott and Darby Street. Spoke with manager Ethan from Lumi Cafe about living conditions in the city and the increase of vagrants on the street. Heading towards Woolworths.
Welfare check on Domino's, Wilson Carpark, Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse — no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Puffing Kiwi, Sails Mart and Look Sharp all clear; heading through Lorne Street.
Arrived at the Library; nothing to report on Lorne Street or at the Library. Heading towards Munster Inn.
All clear at Munster Inn; large crowds at Aotea Square for Diwali. Heading back to the office for break.
Notified of a break-in and attempted burglary at Tenact, which occurred at 02:30. If we sight the individual we will notify management.
Arrived at the office; on break.
Response call from Good To Go Supermarket on Albert Street — the caller sounded frantic, asking us to hurry; heading there now.

Saw Police standing by in front of Woolworths; approached and notified them of the urgency — a female worker asking for assistance as if her life was in danger. They responded that they had not received a call-out about it and asked us to call if anything were to happen.
Approaching Good To Go, saw a vagrant coming from that direction in an orange hi-vis shirt with a Countdown bag, limping towards Victoria Street via Albert Street.

Arrived at Good To Go; the worker confirmed it was him. She could not explain the situation fully, but members of the public advised the POI had tried to steal and failed when people intervened. Heading back to the office to charge the Ops Phone.
Charging the Ops Phone — on 4%. (Photo on file.)

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 21:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Bodycam, 5 x Keys.
First guard on site; standing by for the second guard.
Second guard has arrived; short debrief before commencing patrols.
Gearing up completed; patrolling down Queen Street commencing welfare checks.
Call from Chemist Warehouse to keep an eye out for a POI described by staff, walking down Queen Street; keeping watch while continuing patrols.
Full sweep of Durham Street; welfare checks on the corner of Durham, BBQ Duck, Durham Supermart, Hazy Tiger and both Wilson carparks, all clear. Continuing welfare checks down Queen Street.
Welfare checks from Mecca and Farmers down to OPSM and Hallensteins — all stores clear, no issues. Commencing sweep up Wyndham.
Full sweep of Wyndham Street; welfare checks on QFTAV bar, Chemist Warehouse, Melba, all clear. Continuing welfare checks down Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street; welfare checks from JB Hi-Fi and Macpac down to ANZ and Van Cleef & Arpels, all clear. Arrived at Britomart commencing sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare checks on McDonald's, Commercial Bay shopping centre and the Downtown waterfront, all clear.
Response call from Cotton On regarding a male individual who walked out of the store with stolen goods; en route to the location.
Arrived at the response location; obtained a description of the male shoplifter. Patrolling the area to spot the described POI.

Spotted a male matching the description given by Cotton On staff; approached him and asked for the stolen products back. He denied it was him and ran from our presence through Darby Street; chased him but could not catch him. Patrolling the area to find the individual.
Countdown and Chemist Warehouse on Victoria Street all clear; patrolling the train station to potentially find the individual.
Te Waihorotiu train station all clear; notified train security to keep an eye out.
Standing by in the middle of Queen Street in front of Mecca maintaining presence.

Approached by a member of the public repeatedly and aggressively questioning the Auckland Council guards next to us about the difference between busking and begging, coming back and forth with the same question. Intervened before the situation could escalate and asked the member of the public to move along — no issues.
Response call from 77 Convenience Store on Commerce Street regarding a male individual outside the premises unconscious and not responding to anyone; en route to the location.

Arrived at the response location; the male was indeed unconscious outside and not moving. After a few shakes he was finally able to open his eyes and move; kindly asked him to move along with his belongings.
The male individual and his belongings have been moved along. Welfare checks on 77 Convenience Store, The White Lady and Jo & Joes, all clear; patrolling to Britomart.
Full sweep of Commerce Street with welfare checks, all clear. At Britomart sweeping and patrolling the area for the Cotton On shoplifter.
Full sweep of Britomart; welfare checks on McDonald's and Commercial Bay shopping centre — no potential leads on the Cotton On shoplifter. Heading to Headquarters.
Arrived at Headquarters; standing by outside maintaining presence until floor checks.
Heading into the office to prepare for floor checks.
Floor checks completed; short break before patrolling.
Break completed. Call received from management requesting assistance with swiping them into the office.
Assistance with management complete, all clear, no issues to report; continuing patrols.
Welfare checks on McDonald's, Avachi, Timezone, 77 Convenience Store and Mid City centre, all clear.
Full sweep of upper Queen Street; welfare checks on all remaining open businesses. Standing by at the top of Queen Street for the Diwali festival.
Standing by at the top of Queen Street.
Welfare check on the Diwali festival and public presence, all clear; patrolling up Wellesley to Elliott.
Wellesley Street all clear; welfare checks on Wellesley Mart and Father Teds. Arrived at Elliott Stables maintaining presence.
Call from an Auckland Council member regarding a member of the public busking in front of Westpac, lower Queen Street, without a permit; en route to the location.

Arrived at the location; kindly approached the male individual and asked him to move along. He was very compliant with us but very hurt and angry at the Auckland Council guards. Maintaining presence until the individual left the site.
Individual moved along, no issues to report. Having a chat with the Auckland Council guards to get the background before heading back to Headquarters.
Standing down from the chat with the Council guards, all clear; patrolling to Shortland Street.
Arrived on Shortland Street maintaining presence at Mothership.
Mothership all clear, no issues; commencing break — buying food.
Arrived at Headquarters; continuing the 30-minute break (20:45–21:10).
Call from management to stand by at Bar 101; en route to the location.
Afternoon Shift concluded; handing over to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (21:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Still standing by at Bar 101 with the Afternoon Shift guards.
Received word from management to relieve the Afternoon guards.
Arrived at the office; charging the Ops Phone and standing by for the third guard to arrive.
Commencing patrols with the Ops Phone sitting at 28%.
Heavy foot traffic from members of the public; patrolling along Queen Street ensuring a strong security presence.
Arrived back at HQ for the third guard to prep up.
Check-in at Bar 101; welfare check on all stores within Elliott Street, all clear. Standing by to ensure our presence is visible.
Check-in at Ace Karaoke and Ace Live House; checked in on the static guards, all clear.
Arrived at the Customs and Albert Street intersection, no issues found.
Check-in at Commercial Bay; full walkthrough and quick sweep of the area completed. Checked in on McDonald's Britomart and Club Kong, all clear.
Patrolling up Queen Street again, maintaining a strong security presence.
Response call from Bar 101 reporting a female individual knocked out and currently unconscious.
Called an ambulance for the individual and waited for it to arrive. She got up shortly, yelled at members of the public asking why they were recording her, then collapsed again.

Police patrolling by stopped and offered assistance; after Police came along to check on the female she quickly got up and moved along with her partner. Continuing to stand by to ensure a strong security presence.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street reporting a group of females consuming alcohol inside their bathroom.
Arrived at the response location; the group of individuals had already left the premises. Standing by to show presence before moving along.
Arrived back at Elliott Street to ensure a strong security presence.
Arrived at HQ to take off our jackets.
Heading back out towards Elliott Street to continue ensuring a strong security presence.
Received a call from an HOTC guard that he is ready to continue on shift.
Full sweep of Darby Street, no issues; at Bar 101 maintaining presence due to heavy crowds in the area.
Bar 101 has closed; heavy crowd outside — standing by for any assistance needed (04:00–04:30).
Full sweep of Bar 101, all clear; crowd control complete with no issues. Continuing patrols.
Victoria Street all clear, no issues; patrolling down High Street.
Arrived at Freyberg Place commencing sweep of the area.
Full sweep of Freyberg Place; welfare checks on Chancery Street and O'Connell Street, all clear. Patrolling down High Street.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep of the whole of High Street, all clear; patrolling Shortland Street.
Shortland Street all clear, no issues; patrolling up Queen Street.
Full sweep of Queen Street, all clear; at the office commencing a 30-minute break (05:29–06:00).
Break completed; standing by in the office awaiting guard handover.
Night Shift concluded; handing over to the Morning Shift.

flags: EVENT: Diwali festival road closures with the Prime Minister and Brian Tamaki in attendance; multiple event-related taskings and crowd standbys through the day; Night Shift ran a third guard.
QA: 13:13 Police declined to attend the Good To Go Supermarket call (no call-out received on their end); the team handled the response alone.
STAFFING: Afternoon — second guard arrived 14:46; patrols commenced 15:15.
SHIFT TIMES: Afternoon shift concluded 21:30; Night Shift team on post from 21:30.
